growth_signal.value: Seed round about four times the pre-seed within a short time; public launch with a free trial; founders of Lovable, Supercell and Langdock invested

raised.value: $10.3M seed in September 2026 led by Primary Venture Partners, after a $2.7M pre-seed

entry.idea: Replaces the sales team's CRM with AI agents that find likely buyers, write to them, update the records and watch which customers are about to leave.
entry.lesson: Do not bolt AI onto the old tool; make the data entry disappear and sell the outcome, which is customers found, won and kept.
entry.name: Zero

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last
growth.reason: No customer numbers yet; the company only just launched publicly.

market.reason: Every company with a sales team pays for a CRM; it is one of the largest software categories in the world.

tech.reason: Agents on top of rentable models, but the buying-signal engine and the founders' Smartly.io experience give a real head start.

entry.twist: Instead of asking salespeople to fill in a database, it watches buying signals like job postings and does the record-keeping itself.
entry.who_pays: Sales teams at growing software companies pay a subscription; there is a free trial and AI-assisted migration from the old CRM.
entry.why_now: AI agents can now read the open web for signals and hold outreach conversations, so the manual CRM looks like paperwork nobody wants.
